population_one_line: Adult internal medicine patients with bacteremia, paired pre/post-antibiotic blood cultures, Tel Aviv, Israel
ttp_reported: Not TTP. Study measured time between antibiotic administration and post-antibiotic blood culture obtainment (mean 6.66 h)
outcome_one_line: Outcome = post-antibiotic blood culture positivity (microbiological), not a clinical outcome. OR 0.89 per 60 min for time between antibiotic and BCO
notes: The 'time' variable in regression is NOT time-to-positivity; it is time from antibiotic dose to blood culture draw. Outcome is microbiological (BC sterilization), not clinical. Mortality reported descriptively in Table 1 but no TTP-mortality association. Excluded: no TTP exposure as defined for our meta-analysis.

population_one_line: Adult anaerobic bacteremia, tertiary hospital, Charleroi, Belgium (2018-2019)
ttp_reported: Median TTP 29.9 h (IQR 19.8-47.3); dichotomized at 30 h
outcome_one_line: 30-day mortality: TTP >=30 h independent protective factor, Cox HR 0.24 (95% CI 0.07-0.84), p=0.025; univariate OR 0.17 (0.06-0.49), p=0.001
notes: Clean fit. TTP defined as time from incubation start to detection. Adjusted Cox model includes sepsis, antibiotic adequacy, Charlson, etc. 30-day mortality 21.9%.
